title: Harden scoped indexes against stale state and hash collisions
description: Make scoped allocation fail with an actionable error when index-{branchId}.json records a different branch name than the current branch. Before allocating, compare the proposed short ID with loaded tasks and advance past already-used sequences so a stale or manually lowered index cannot duplicate a task. Preserve atomicity and acceptable gaps when index persistence succeeds but task publication fails. Add internal flat-file tests for stale indexes, missing scoped indexes with existing scoped tasks, exact 32-bit hash-collision metadata mismatch, concurrent writers, and failure paths that do not overwrite task files. Avoid broad scheduler changes.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected scoped flat-file allocation: branch metadata validation and global locking are present, but CreateTask still uses index.Next directly. Implementing allocation-time short-ID collision advancement plus focused stale/missing-index and publication-failure coverage; preserving existing worktree changes and avoiding scheduler edits.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented scoped allocation hardening: reject index metadata owned by another branch with branch-ID collision/stale-index guidance; advance proposed IDs past all loaded tasks so stale or missing indexes cannot duplicate; retain index-first persistence and atomic task publication so failed publication leaves the prior task unchanged with an acceptable counter gap. Added internal tests for stale/missing indexes, an exact 32-bit SHA-256 prefix collision, concurrent writers, and publication failure. Verified with go test ./internal/provider/flatfile, go test -race ./internal/provider/flatfile, go test ./..., and ./scripts/verify.sh commit (format, tests, vet, smoke).
